structured.answer: If I have to pick, it's Harel, the "כספי (שקלי)" track. It shows "מניות 0%" and "מט"ח 0%", 4.25% a year over 3 years and 3.08% over 5, and 0.57% to Harel, which I know is a big insurance company. Before I sign anything I'll ask you or the bank whether that is really better than my deposit once the fee comes off.

stuck.why: A black page from "מקור", a name I don't know. Only the words "מנתוני רשות שוק ההון" made me trust it enough to go on.

stuck.where: Harel's list, the "פחות מ־3 שנים" lines
stuck.why: Many tracks have no return number, only "פחות מ־3 שנים". I didn't know if that means the track is new, or something bad.
I wasn't sure if that 0.57% comes off once or every year, or if the bank takes something on top. That is exactly what I wanted to know: is someone taking too much?

stuck.where: "כספי (שקלי)": 4.25% next to 3 שנים, 3.08% next to 5 שנים
stuck.why: Why is the 5-year number lower than the 3-year one? Is 4.25% each year, or for all three years together? The heading "תשואה שנתית ממוצעת" says yearly, but I'm not sure I read it right.
24.04% and 14.64% next to "מניות 94%" stayed in my head. It looks like gambling, and it scared me more than it tempted me.

used: The "קופת גמל להשקעה" button and the line "מנתוני רשות שוק ההון"
Harel's heading: "דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%" and 19.1 billion ₪
The "כספי (שקלי)" card: 0.57% מהחיסכון, 0% from deposits, מניות 0%, מט"ח 0%, 4.25% over 3 years, 3.08% over 5 years
The "אג"ח סחיר" and "אשראי ואג"ח" cards, with 0% or 5% מניות
Mor's heading: 0.67% to 0.73%, which is more than Harel
skimmed: The filter boxes "חיפוש", "במה הכסף מושקע" and "מיון"
The share-heavy tracks on screens 3–6 (כללי, הלכה, מניות סחיר, משולב סחיר, קיימות)
skipped: Screens 7 to 40. I was tired after six screens.
The link "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה"
The other products: קרן השתלמות, חיסכון לכל ילד and the rest
unsure_meaning: "עוקב מדדי אג"ח" and "עוקב מדדי מניות": to me מדד is the price index on the news
"מט"ח" with a percent: does it mean dollars?
The dotted purple lines under the numbers
Why the 5-year return is lower than the 3-year one
not_found: Any comparison with a bank deposit or its interest
A plain sentence saying which track is safe, like a deposit
Whether I can take the money out at any time, and what it costs
What 0.57% means in shekels on my money

findings.what: There is no plain sentence saying which track is safe and close to a deposit. I had to work it out myself from "מניות 0%".
"פחות מ־3 שנים" appears where the return should be, and nothing explains it.
A very dark page with many numbers on every card. It made me anxious and tired quickly.
Big numbers like 24.04% show without saying they come with the risk of a big loss.
I want the fee in shekels per year on an amount I type in, not only as a percent.
There are many words I don't know: עוקב מדדים, סחיר, מט"ח, גמיש.
The round charts in close colours told me nothing.
A list this long, 40 screens, doesn't let a person like me reach the other companies.
The name "מקור" is unknown and the page doesn't say who is behind it.
